name: SAINTOS V2 - 01 VISUAL CEO COMMAND CENTER

parameters.content:
# SaintOS Mega Agent V2

Visual CEO command center built by Saint Sauveur N'Guessan.

n8n AI Agent -> Manager Agents -> Specialist Workers -> Approval -> Output.

## Inputs

Gmail, WhatsApp, Telegram, voice and portal intake.

## Normalize

One payload format for all channels.

## CEO AI Agent

n8n AI Agent with model, memory and workflow tools.

## Safety

Memory, approval, audit and monitoring.

## Outputs

Drafts only until human approval.
